description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="Invitation to make an offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Shipping offer"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Ship goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehousemen" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Unspecified" name="Unspecified responsibility">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_GoodsToShip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Amount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TransportMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceNecessary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GoodsToShip" name="Goods shall be shipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Clarify who will do the shipping"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelStart" name="Packaging and shipping arrangements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package the goods"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount" name="Determine shipment amount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistics companies to make offers" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers from logistics companies" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Select one logistics company"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TransportMerge" name="Shipping method selected" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Write a package label"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceNecessary" name="Is parcel insurance necessary?" default="Flow_InsuranceNotNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" name="Insurance decision complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AllReady" name="Packaging and shipping arrangements ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods prepared for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Clarify" sourceRef="Start_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clarify_Split" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Package" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_Ready" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_AllReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Amount" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Amount_Large" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountIsLarge</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_Receive" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Select" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_TransportMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_TransportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Amount_Small" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_NormalPost">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountIsSmall</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NormalPost_TransportMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_TransportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransportMerge_Label" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Label_Insurance" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceNecessary" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuranceIsNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNotNecessary" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceNecessary" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeInsurance_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceMerge_Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_AllReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_Prepare" sourceRef="Gateway_AllReady" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_End" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="End_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping process" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" name="Three logistics companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
